summary: After A3, v1 terrain-transitions matches 88/137 screens. The first RNG difference at segment 0 step 87 is C trap.c:water_damage() rn2(20) during inventory damage on pool entry versus JS rn2(8) in the later crawl shuffle. JS trap.c:drown skips water_damage_chain(), so six item-damage rolls and the resulting potion dilution messages are missing. Port trap.c:water_damage_chain() whole and wire its active callers in source order.

source.branch: At step 87, the hero moves into a pool. hack.c:pooleffects() calls trap.c:drown(); drown() calls water_damage_chain(gi.invent,FALSE) before its gremlin/iron-golem and escape branches. The chain visits inventory objects in nobj order and invokes already-ported water_damage(obj,NULL,FALSE); the C return value is discarded.
callers: Selected route: cmd.c movement -> hack.c:domove()/spoteffects()/pooleffects() -> trap.c:drown() -> water_damage_chain(gi.invent,FALSE). JS trap.js:drown() currently records note_unported at this exact call.
Same-file trap.c:water_damage() recurses into water_damage_chain(obj->cobj,FALSE) when a container admits water; js/trap_water_damage.js damageContents() currently leaves that gap.
Other C callers: fountain.c:gush; objnam.c:wizterrainwish; dig.c:liquid_flow; mon.c:minliquid. mcastu.c:mcast_geyser is #if 0 and excluded.
dependencies: water_damage() already uses rn2(20) in js/trap_water_damage.js and has return value ignored by the chain.
Use one state.ga.acid_ctx and state.gb.bhitpos value, save and restore bhitpos, and preserve nobj versus nexthere traversal with next saved before mutation.
get_obj_location(obj,CONTAINED_TOO) is implemented; check its return and visibility context before updating bhitpos.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/20260925214017-v1.json at 017038c1e14957228ef42eeb319448e71159eb24 reports 88/137 matching screens, 3182/3811 RNG calls, 107/137 cursors, and 49 remaining screens for this case.

At segment 0 step 87, C draws rn2(20)=12 from trap.c:water_damage() at line 4771; JS first draws rn2(8)=4 in the later drown crawl shuffle. The first screen mismatch is step 88, including missing potion dilution effects.
